name: electrobun-vanilla-vite
description: Electrobun app with vanilla TypeScript and Vite HMR

scripts.dev:hmr: electrobun prepare && concurrently "vite --port 5173" "vite build && electrobun dev"
scripts.start: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun dev
scripts.dev: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.build: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:canary: electrobun prepare && vite build && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:signed: bash -c 'set -a; source release.env; set +a; bun run build'
